calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(v) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (
    SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21') GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_net, COUNT(*) AS days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.store_id, m.net_sales, c.ctl_net, round(m.net_sales-c.ctl_net,2) AS diff, c.days
FROM ctl c LEFT JOIN mine m USING(store_id)
WHERE m.net_sales IS NULL OR abs(m.net_sales-c.ctl_net)>0.5
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, SUM(m.net_sales), SUM(c.ctl_net), round(SUM(m.net_sales)-SUM(c.ctl_net),2), count(*) FROM ctl c LEFT JOIN mine m USING(store_id)
ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, SUM(net_amount) amt, MIN(sales_line_id) mn, MAX(sales_line_id) mx FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l) AS lines, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d) AS dup_keys, (SELECT SUM(amt - amt/c) FROM d) AS extra_amt,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM l) AS dist_ids, (SELECT min(sale_date) FROM l) mind, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM l) maxd,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM l) etl_vals, (SELECT min(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) etl_min, (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) etl_max

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT (product_key, quantity, net_amount, sale_ts_utc, member_key)) same_content, MIN(etl_loaded_at) e1, MAX(etl_loaded_at) e2, MAX(sale_date) sd FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT c, same_content, COUNT(*) n, MIN(sd) min_sd, MAX(sd) max_sd, MIN(e1) min_e1, MAX(e1) max_e1, MIN(e2) min_e2, MAX(e2) max_e2 FROM d GROUP BY 1,2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
